name: omnilab/uniprot
description: Omnilab UniProt: a protein of UniProtKB by accession or entry name - its names, gene, organism, function, length, mass and sequence, cofactors, ligands, location and keywords, its NCBI Gene and Ensembl genes as cross-references, its organism, PDB structures and ligands as related things - and UniProt's search, through the UniProt REST API, no key needed.
